verdict.rationale: BugSnag's docs show you can filter by release and identify which release an error was introduced in (bugsnag-docs-4). Release annotations on the timeline correlate versions with error-rate changes (bugsnag-docs-25), the CLI creates builds that enrich releases (bugsnag-docs-12, bugsnag-docs-45), and stack traces link to source lines on some platforms (bugsnag-docs-43). Nothing in the evidence shows commit association or suspect-commit identification on an issue. missing for 10: suspect-commit attribution per issue, documented commit/SCM association with releases, independent or hands-on corroboration.
